title: The Stock Market Is LYING to You… Here's What's REALLY Happening
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: S&P at record highs is carried by a handful of AI/memory names while most stocks are below their 200-day MA, a fragile 'two-legged table' similar to late 2021.
NFCI shows conditions tightening and rising rates/high-yield spreads add downward pressure on stocks.
Memory makers (Micron, SanDisk) are genuinely profiting from an AI-driven shortage that may run through 2028.

calls.reason: Breadth deterioration (net new lows, % above 200DMA falling from 72% to ~47%, A/D line diverging) plus tightening NFCI; recommends buying Jan 15 QQQ 710 puts (~5% OTM) as 3-month portfolio insurance.
calls.quote: The January 15 QQQ $710 put. Now, what that's going to give you is 3 months of protection.

calls.reason: Index at record highs but breadth weak and A/D line rolling over like late 2021 before the 2022 bear market; warns of downside risk while not calling a crash.
calls.quote: we're seeing weakness in the advanced decline before the market

notes: Hedging trade, not an outright bearish forecast; host says narrow markets can persist 3-9 months. Put entry 15.5 is option premium per share. 'As of Monday'/'beginning of the week' suggests mid-week recording.
